digest.component_or_area: Plan review criterion registration and container pass
propositions: Plan review certified tickets with mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across parent and children with zero blocking findings, causing contradictions to surface only mid-implementation or at completion-verification
Acceptance criteria must be jointly satisfiable with Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations, but no existing criterion owns this concern — COH disclaims within-section checks and E1/F1 check other aspects
The ac-satisfiability criterion must detect three shapes of set-quantification contradiction: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality
G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because its sibling roster contains only ids and titles, lacking the acceptance-criteria items needed to test whether children collectively cover parent criteria

The sibling roster is independently built in three non-test locations (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), causing divergence between production and eval harnesses; it must be single-sourced via a shared helper and moved into the system prompt prefix to avoid repeated transmission and include its token cost in prefix budgeting
